about: eleven unread threads fill the digit keys and spill onto a second page. taps focus threads on both pages, nl flips drive to fleet and back, a double tap aims dictation, plus marks the top call read, a machine key opens compose, a hold on nl toggles deep work, and a double tap on nl drops the board into calc and back.

steps.label: the daemon starts, then the board is plugged in
tap k2: focus kilo on page two
tap dot: wrap to page one
tap k3 in fleet: no verb
double k3: aim dictation at charlie
tap plus: mark the top call read
tap div: compose on the first machine
double nl: the firmware drops to calc
double nl: the firmware returns to drive
the board rests while telemetry flushes
